title: Invisible icon in "General Configuration" preview with mixed light/dark theme like Breeze Twilight
line: With a dark Plasma style and light app colours (Breeze Twilight), the launcher icon preview in Kickoff and Kicker settings is now light on the dark panel graphic instead of nearly invisible.
explanation: The icon preview in the Kickoff and Kicker settings draws the launcher icon on a Plasma panel graphic, which follows the Plasma style, but the icon takes its colour from the settings window, which follows the application colours. With Breeze Twilight (dark Plasma style, light app colours) the symbolic icon is dark grey on a dark frame. Config windows use their own QML engine with the desktop Kirigami theme, so there was no way in QML to read the Plasma style's colours there. libplasma now has a PlasmaCore.ThemeColors singleton exposing the Plasma style's colours (updating on theme changes), and both previews colour the icon with its text colour.

commits.message:
declarativeimports/core: add a ThemeColors singleton

Config dialogs follow the application colors, so items drawn on top of
Plasma style graphics there can't get the Plasma colors through
Kirigami.Theme. Add a singleton that exposes the Plasma style's colors.

CCBUG: 525301

applets/kicker, kickoff: use Plasma colors for the icon preview

The icon preview draws the launcher icon on a Plasma panel graphic, but
the icon took the application colors, so with Breeze Twilight it was a
dark icon on a dark panel. Color it with the Plasma style's colors.

BUG: 525301

From 83dd740cf2511d948b4abf89c40b3f6b321d815b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001

Subject: [PATCH] declarativeimports/core: add a ThemeColors singleton

Config dialogs follow the application colors, so items drawn on top of
Plasma style graphics there can't get the Plasma colors through
Kirigami.Theme. Add a singleton that exposes the Plasma style's colors.

CCBUG: 525301
---

diff --git a/src/declarativeimports/core/themecolors.cpp b/src/declarativeimports/core/themecolors.cpp
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..2b8cb10ed
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/declarativeimports/core/themecolors.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#include "themecolors.h"
+
+ThemeColors::ThemeColors(QObject *parent)
+    : QObject(parent)
+{
+    connect(&m_theme, &Plasma::Theme::themeChanged, this, &ThemeColors::colorsChanged);
+}
+
+QColor ThemeColors::textColor() const
+{
+    return m_theme.color(Plasma::Theme::TextColor);
+}
+
+QColor ThemeColors::disabledTextColor() const
+{
+    return m_theme.color(Plasma::Theme::DisabledTextColor);
+}
+
+QColor ThemeColors::backgroundColor() const
+{
+    return m_theme.color(Plasma::Theme::BackgroundColor);
+}
+
+QColor ThemeColors::highlightColor() const
+{
+    return m_theme.color(Plasma::Theme::HighlightColor);
+}
+
+QColor ThemeColors::highlightedTextColor() const
+{
+    return m_theme.color(Plasma::Theme::HighlightedTextColor);
+}
+
+QColor ThemeColors::positiveTextColor() const
+{
+    return m_theme.color(Plasma::Theme::PositiveTextColor);
+}
+
+QColor ThemeColors::neutralTextColor() const
+{
+    return m_theme.color(Plasma::Theme::NeutralTextColor);
+}
+
+QColor ThemeColors::negativeTextColor() const
+{
+    return m_theme.color(Plasma::Theme::NegativeTextColor);
+}
+
+#include "moc_themecolors.cpp"
diff --git a/src/declarativeimports/core/themecolors.h b/src/declarativeimports/core/themecolors.h
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..ae5dbf118
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/declarativeimports/core/themecolors.h
@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#ifndef THEMECOLORS_H
+#define THEMECOLORS_H
+
+#include <Plasma/Theme>
+
+#include <QColor>
+#include <QObject>
+#include <qqmlregistration.h>
+
+/*!
+ * \qmltype ThemeColors
+ * \inqmlmodule org.kde.plasma.core
+ * \inherits QtObject
+ *
+ * \brief The colors of the current Plasma style.
+ *
+ * Inside Plasma windows, Kirigami.Theme already provides these colors. Use this
+ * singleton for content drawn on top of Plasma style graphics in windows that
+ * follow the application colors instead, such as a preview of a panel in an
+ * applet's configuration dialog.
+ *
+ * Example usage:
+ * \qml
+ * Kirigami.Icon {
+ *     Kirigami.Theme.textColor: PlasmaCore.ThemeColors.textColor
+ * }
+ * \endqml
+ *
+ * \since 6.9
+ */
+class ThemeColors : public QObject
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+    QML_ELEMENT
+    QML_SINGLETON
+
+    /*!
+     * \qmlproperty color ThemeColors::textColor
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(QColor textColor READ textColor NOTIFY colorsChanged)
+
+    /*!
+     * \qmlproperty color ThemeColors::disabledTextColor
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(QColor disabledTextColor READ disabledTextColor NOTIFY colorsChanged)
+
+    /*!
+     * \qmlproperty color ThemeColors::backgroundColor
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(QColor backgroundColor READ backgroundColor NOTIFY colorsChanged)
+
+    /*!
+     * \qmlproperty color ThemeColors::highlightColor
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(QColor highlightColor READ highlightColor NOTIFY colorsChanged)
+
+    /*!
+     * \qmlproperty color ThemeColors::highlightedTextColor
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(QColor highlightedTextColor READ highlightedTextColor NOTIFY colorsChanged)
+
+    /*!
+     * \qmlproperty color ThemeColors::positiveTextColor
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(QColor positiveTextColor READ positiveTextColor NOTIFY colorsChanged)
+
+    /*!
+     * \qmlproperty color ThemeColors::neutralTextColor
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(QColor neutralTextColor READ neutralTextColor NOTIFY colorsChanged)
+
+    /*!
+     * \qmlproperty color ThemeColors::negativeTextColor
+     */
+    Q_PROPERTY(QColor negativeTextColor READ negativeTextColor NOTIFY colorsChanged)
+
+public:
+    explicit ThemeColors(QObject *parent = nullptr);
+
+    QColor textColor() const;
+    QColor disabledTextColor() const;
+    QColor backgroundColor() const;
+    QColor highlightColor() const;
+    QColor highlightedTextColor() const;
+    QColor positiveTextColor() const;
+    QColor neutralTextColor() const;
+    QColor negativeTextColor() const;
+
+Q_SIGNALS:
+    void colorsChanged();
+
+private:
+    Plasma::Theme m_theme;
+};
+
+#endif // THEMECOLORS_H
--

From 045c8da918ed28901492b8b0d4788bafd8abb1f4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 01:10:35 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kicker, kickoff: use Plasma colors for the icon
 preview

The icon preview draws the launcher icon on a Plasma panel graphic, but
the icon took the application colors, so with Breeze Twilight it was a
dark icon on a dark panel. Color it with the Plasma style's colors.

BUG: 525301
---
 applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml  | 2 ++
 applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml | 2 ++
 2 files changed, 4 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 673855d546..7fb43b08e0 100644
--- a/applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/kicker/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -121,6 +121,8 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
                     width: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.large
                     height: width
                     source: configGeneral.cfg_useCustomButtonImage ? configGeneral.cfg_customButtonImage : configGeneral.cfg_icon
+
+                    Kirigami.Theme.textColor: PlasmaCore.ThemeColors.textColor
                 }
             }
 
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 025cba4c49..e83fa742c7 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -80,6 +80,8 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
                     width: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.large
                     height: width
                     source: Tools.iconOrDefault(Plasmoid.formFactor, root.cfg_icon)
+
+                    Kirigami.Theme.textColor: PlasmaCore.ThemeColors.textColor
                 }
             }
 
--
